title: Your company details
intro: We need these details to verify your company. Until then your account is pending: you can add listings and contacts, but not share or publish them.

fields.name: Company name
fields.taxIdHint: Company CIF (e.g. B12345674), or NIF/NIE for a self-employed agent.
fields.registerNumberHint: Your regional estate-agent register number where your region requires one (e.g. AICAT in Catalonia). It cannot change after verification.

saved: Saved. Our team will review your company shortly.

errors.taxIdFormat: This is not a Spanish CIF, NIF or NIE. Example: B12345674.
errors.taxIdControl: The last digit or letter does not match the number. Please check it for typos.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed these details meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
errors.forbidden: Only an administrator of your company can change these details.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.locked: Your company is verified: its name, tax id and register number can only change through our team.

VERIFY_AGENCY.title: Verify your agency
VERIFY_AGENCY.body: Send your company details and documents. Once we approve them you can share listings and publish them on your website.

IMPORT_LISTINGS.title: Add or import your listings
IMPORT_LISTINGS.body: Add a listing, or connect your feed or spreadsheet to bring in your whole portfolio.

CONNECT_WEBSITE.title: Connect your website
CONNECT_WEBSITE.body: Create a website connection so your listings appear on your own site.

INVITE_TEAM.title: Invite your team
INVITE_TEAM.body: Invite your agents so they can work on listings and clients with you.

SHARE_LISTING.title: Share your first listing
SHARE_LISTING.body: Share a listing with other agencies (or publish it) to start collaborating on the network.

intro.title: Welcome to Inmolink
intro.body: A quick look at where to start. Your checklist ticks itself as you go.

steps.VERIFY_AGENCY: Verification is here: send your company details and documents for review.
steps.IMPORT_LISTINGS: Your listings live here: add one, or import them from your feed or a spreadsheet.
steps.CONNECT_WEBSITE: Connect your website here to show your listings on your own site.
steps.INVITE_TEAM: Invite your agents and manage their roles here.
steps.SHARE_LISTING: Open a listing and change its visibility to share it with other agencies.

support.title: We are here to help
support.body: Questions? Open a support ticket at any time.
